source: Own measurement, 2026-11-24, NATIVE and OUTSIDE THE ENGINE: it has to be measured again through `ale validate` before the task is merged. The privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) was run through this folder's verify stage (tests/verify.py as an ordinary account, the kit's Solver and probe lock, one fresh cell process per pack) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs) in the author's Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 / Isaac Lab 3.0.0 environment on the author's server (RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570, PhysX on the CPU), on the tree of commit 230187b: mean_pack_credit 1.00000 (every pack 1.0: 49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed), no protective stop, probe pairs 77 of 77 differing (50 idle pairs not counted), 852 to 1185 steps and 601 to 813 s of simulated time per pack, the reference's own time 6 s, the stage 1166 s. No Docker on that server: the image was never built, the cell never ran as its own account, and no engine gate has run. Two repeats on the tree of 21ac344 (the same cell, grader and reference) gave the same value step for step, and with the value 1.0 recorded the reference scored reward 1.0 and an empty submission 0.0, natively. Those and the earlier runs are in tests/README.md, section 6. The tree changed twice since: the kit of upstream 1c13a47 and a rebuilt probe copy (tests/README.md, section 6, the entry "18:20 to 19:00"), on which the reference scored 1.00000 again (tree 152fdf7, the probe lock 83 of 83); then an exact conversion of a pose near a half turn (the entry "19:10 to 20:30"). THE VALUE IS THE MEASUREMENT ON THAT TREE (15d8694, same environment, GPU 3 of the server only): mean_pack_credit 0.99440 (packs 0 and 1: 0.97315 and 0.99324, five fasteners thrown out of the fasteners bins when the reference released a fastener into its own pile; packs 2 to 5: 1.0, every pack in the same steps as before), the probe lock 83 of 83, no protective stop; a second run of packs 0 and 1 gave the same two values. Before that tree the value was 1.0.
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step; the one spread measured is that of a small perturbation of its trajectory (the conversion change of 15d8694), which moved mean_pack_credit from 1.00000 to 0.99440 (one pack by 2.7 %), and 0.95 leaves about nine times that. It leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that bounces out of a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). It has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts.
